title: Comprehensive Variable Model & Cascade Example
description: A 'Master Example' showcasing progressive disclosure in the FAIR Variable Model: flat property annotations, generic variable references (fair:variableRef), and external standard-specific references (instance, represented, and conceptual levels).

SHARED_INCOME_VAR.title: Shared Variable: Gross Annual Income
SHARED_INCOME_VAR.description: A reusable definition of annual gross income before tax.

REPRESENTED_EMPLOYMENT_BINARY.title: Represented: Active/Inactive Binary
REPRESENTED_EMPLOYMENT_BINARY.description: A shared coding scheme for employment status.
REPRESENTED_EMPLOYMENT_BINARY.fair:universe: Adult human beings of working age

q0_income.title: Income (Generic Variable Ref)
q0_income.description: Generic reference linking to a shared variable definition via fair:variableRef.

q1_age.title: Age (External Instance Variable)
q1_age.description: Full formal mapping where a dataset-specific variable points to an external registry entry.
q1_age.$comment: Tools find 'Person' (Unit Type) and 'General Pop' (Universe) by traversing the external URI.

q2_employment.title: Employment (Internal Pure Cascade)
q2_employment.description: Lineage built entirely within the schema using internal references.

q3_satisfaction.title: Satisfaction (External Instance Variable)
q3_satisfaction.description: Mapping to an external dataset field definition.
q3_satisfaction.fair:label: Overall life satisfaction

q4_pop_count.title: Population Count (External Statistical Variable)
q4_pop_count.description: Mapping to an external statistical variable definition.

q5_voter_status.title: Voter Status (Standalone Flat Annotation)
q5_voter_status.description: No external variable record; just direct flat annotations for population and phenomenon.
